title: Negative for C:ecology-with-reproduction via evopursuit: predators raise prey bodies 5x and prey fissions 30x, both species die at the matched food and prey forks, but under predation prey keep their identity only ~10 t (median) between fission/fusion events, so they are a fission-fusion population, not persistent reproducing individuals
summary: world.py is evopursuit with every prey carrying the evasion allele (B0=1, e=1, cost 0.15, m=0; lab 1's arms_B_pred), species tracking and two forks. Prey-only ledger at 2-t sampling (ecotrack.py: largest-piece identity, fission = >=2 pieces each >=25% of parent mass, true merge = >=2 parents each >=25% of the product; lineage.py: a fission is sibling-safe if the daughters' lineages never fuse with each other and two persist 100 t). X: with predators 32.3-32.9 prey bodies (t>=1000) and 1643-1810 prey mass vs 6.1-7.7 and 370-408 in the matched no-predator twin (seeds 0-1; seed 2 32.5); prey fissions 986-1018 per run vs 29-42. E: removing the food at t=1500 takes prey bodies 37 -> 0 by t=1700 (2/2 seeds; pack_food sheets) while the fed twins keep 27-35; removing the prey at t=1500 takes predator bodies 26-30 -> 0 by t=1700 (2/2). D: 183-209 sibling-safe prey fissions per run, strict (merge-free) max generation 2/2/3 on seeds 0-2, predators 143-151 and generation 2-3, but merges outnumber fissions 1.34-1.37x (prey) and 1.5x (predators). I fails under predation: the median age of a prey body (time since its last fission or fusion with a >=25% piece) is 12 t at t=1000-2400 (seed 0; 10 t seed 1; 3% older than 50 t) against 226 t without predators, robust to smoothing 1-2 px and threshold 0.2-0.35 (9-12 t), and still only 31 t (15% >= 100 t) when the largest piece keeps the identity through every fission and fusion; bodies form from noise in ~100 t. With the allele off (e=0) prey are eaten down to 4-5 prey-predator composites (no ecology).

finding.operator: predator chase (evopursuit predation) on dividing Keller-Segel prey swimmers
finding.control: matched no-predator twin (pred=0), food-removal fork and prey-removal fork at t=1500, same seeds and grid; tracker sensitivity to smoothing, threshold and identity rule
finding.result: prey bodies 32-33 vs 6-8 (no predators); fissions ~1000 vs 29-42; food fork: prey 37->0 in 200 t (2/2); prey fork: predators 26-30->0 in 200 t (2/2); sibling-safe fissions 183-209, strict generation 2-3, merges/fissions 1.34-1.37; median prey identity age 10-12 t with predators vs 226 t without (31 t under the largest-piece rule)

limits: One parameter point (lab 1's arms_B_pred). Identity age depends on the tracker's 25% rule; I did not find a rule under which predated prey persist longer than their ~100 t formation time. labkit's own tracking (12 t frames) cannot link these swimmers. E holds partly by construction (growth proportional to n plus a self-toxin death term). Next: a cohesion screen (Da_p 2.5-3) for a regime where prey stay individual under predation is running.
